# Copilot Instructions for AKB Studio

Read `AGENTS.md`, `INSTRUCTIONS.md` and `BRAIN.md` before proposing or editing production source.

Follow the repository decision hierarchy and Audit → Keep → Adjust → Add.

Do not generate generic SaaS layouts, card walls, repeated heading-grid sections, terminal styling, glassmorphism, fake content or decorative motion. Each major section needs a distinct content-led composition and a deliberate mobile transformation.

The About page is frozen. Pravaah uses official server-side discovery, private curation and cached publication. Restricted social sources use manual canonical URLs until approved API credentials exist. Never scrape.

Never modify another repository from this audit workspace. Report every changed file and visible design change.
